scope: Four new unprinted-on-baseline, colorless-identity land names for Ashad ChatGPT Rev2 comparison; web search of public primary Scryfall card records and existing Anhelo Scryfall oracle snapshots.

cards.name: Mishra's Workshop
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {C}{C}{C}. Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells.
cards.usage_warning: The restricted three mana cannot be spent on nonartifact spells or abilities; it pays only generic costs of artifact spells, including Ashad's generic {1} but not U/B/R pips.

cards.name: Ancient Tomb
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {C}{C}. Ancient Tomb deals 2 damage to you.
cards.usage_warning: Colorless only, two life per tapping; one generic pip is payable on Ashad, the remainder needs a valid mana sink.

cards.name: City of Brass
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever this land becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to you.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
cards.usage_warning: Tapped trigger deals damage even when tapped by outside effect; mana-color coverage is unconditional.

cards.name: Mana Confluence
cards.oracle_text: {T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color.
cards.usage_warning: Life is paid as ability activation cost; colored mana available without artifact condition.

method: Manually recorded primary Scryfall card Oracle/Commander legality and Game Changer search results; direct card-ID JSON response was not archived. DO NOT represent this as machine-refetched all-new Scryfall API, or as formal independent M6 I/J certification.
